title: Telecommunications Line Installers and Repairers
description: Install and repair telecommunications cable, including fiber optics.

tasks.text: Splice cables, using hand tools, epoxy, or mechanical equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting electrical components is manual work

dwas.name: Connect electrical components or equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect or test lines or cables, recording and analyzing test results, to assess transmission characteristics and locate faults or malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Performance data analysis; equipment context human

dwas.name: Inspect telecommunications equipment to identify problems.
Analyze test or performance data to assess equipment operation.

tasks.text: Clean or maintain tools or test equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Set up service for customers, installing, connecting, testing, or adjusting equipment, such as digital subscriber line modems.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI reads test data; physical test setup is human

dwas.name: Test communications equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.
Install audio or communications equipment.

tasks.text: Access specific areas to string lines, or install terminal boxes, auxiliary equipment, or appliances, using bucket trucks, climbing poles or ladders, or entering tunnels, trenches, or crawl spaces.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Climbing structures requires physical mobility

dwas.name: Climb equipment or structures to access work areas.

tasks.text: Lay underground cable directly in trenches, or string it through conduits running through trenches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying cables requires physical routing work

dwas.name: Lay cables to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Pull cable through ducts by hand or with winches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying cables requires physical routing work

dwas.name: Lay cables to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Pull up cable by hand from large reels mounted on trucks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying cables requires physical routing work

dwas.name: Lay cables to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Travel to customers' premises to install, maintain, or repair audio and visual electronic reception equipment or accessories.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical travel to sites requires human mobility

dwas.name: Travel to work sites to perform installation, repair or maintenance work.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Measure signal strength at utility poles, using electronic test equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Requires physical gauges and instrument reading

dwas.name: Measure equipment outputs.

tasks.text: Place insulation over conductors, or seal splices with moisture-proof covering.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Insulation installation requires manual fitting

dwas.name: Install insulation in equipment or structures.

tasks.text: Compute impedance of wires from poles to houses to determine additional resistance needed for reducing signals to desired levels.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Calculation from specs; human confirms field conditions

dwas.name: Calculate requirements for equipment installation or repair projects.

tasks.text: Explain cable service to subscribers after installation, and collect any installation fees due.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — AI can script; live explanation and trust are human

dwas.name: Explain use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

dwas.name: Collect payments for goods or services.

tasks.text: String cables between structures and lines from poles, towers, or trenches, and pull lines to proper tension.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying cables requires physical routing work

dwas.name: Lay cables to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Fill and tamp holes, using cement, earth, and tamping devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating compaction equipment by hand on site

dwas.name: Compact materials to create level bases.

tasks.text: Dig trenches for underground wires or cables.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual digging with tools in ground

dwas.name: Dig holes or trenches.

tasks.text: Install equipment such as amplifiers or repeaters to maintain the strength of communications transmissions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing AV equipment requires hands-on wiring

dwas.name: Install audio or communications equipment.

tasks.text: Use a variety of construction equipment to complete installations, such as digger derricks, trenchers, or cable plows.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating heavy equipment by hand in field

dwas.name: Move large objects using heavy equipment.

tasks.text: Dig holes for power poles, using power augers or shovels, set poles in place with cranes, and hoist poles upright, using winches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Dig holes or trenches.
Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Participate in the construction or removal of telecommunication towers or associated support structures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Erecting temporary structures requires physical assembly

dwas.name: Remove worn, damaged or outdated materials from work areas.
Assemble temporary equipment or structures.
Assemble metal structures.
Dismantle equipment or temporary structures.

emerging_tasks.task: Locate and mark cables that are buried underground.
